name: Paylocity
description: Paylocity is a unified HR, payroll, finance, and IT platform for mid-sized organizations, offering modular products across payroll, time and labor, talent management, benefits, expense/AP automation, and IT asset and access management, priced only through a custom sales quote.
best_for: Mid-sized employers wanting HR, payroll, and finance modules on one platform and willing to go through a sales quote rather than self-serve published pricing.
features: Core payroll processing with tax services, on-demand pay, and garnishment services
Time & Labor management including scheduling, attendance, and time collection
Talent management: recruiting, onboarding, performance, compensation, and learning
Finance modules: expense management, corporate cards, AP automation, guided procurement, and spend analytics with fraud detection
IT modules for asset management and access/identity management
Ignite AI features for automation and insights across HR and finance workflows
Employee experience tools including community, recognition, and employee-voice surveys
pros: Customers can implement one or more modules and expand later rather than buying the full suite upfront
Combines HR/payroll with finance modules (AP automation, spend analytics, corporate cards) not offered by every HR-first competitor
Mobile app covers paychecks, clock in/out, schedules, and messages for employees
cons: No pricing is published on paylocity.com; obtaining even a rough estimate requires submitting a form with company size and contact details
No named, self-serve pricing tiers are shown, unlike competitors that publish at least a starting per-employee rate

alternatives.name: Paycom
alternatives.description: A single-database HCM platform covering payroll, talent, HR, and time management, built around employee-driven payroll verification.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-sized employers comparing single-vendor HCM suites with similar breadth to Paylocity.

alternatives.name: ADP Workforce Now
alternatives.description: ADP's HCM suite for small to midsized businesses, combining payroll, HR, time, and talent management.
alternatives.best_for: Employers wanting an established payroll bureau with decades of tax-compliance infrastructure.

alternatives.name: Rippling
alternatives.description: A modular workforce platform unifying HR, payroll, IT device management, and spend management on one employee record.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting IT device management bundled with HR/payroll/finance rather than finance-and-HR without device management.
